Talents and abilities – God given  talents, gifts and abilities

By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to:  identify his/her God given talents, gifts and abilities,  Analyze the God given talents and abilities.  Appreciate the importance of talents and abilities.
How do you  discover your talents, gifts and abilities?

The learner is guided to:  brainstorm what they enjoy doing  while at home, school and in the community  in pairs share experiences of the talents, gifts and unique abilities they possess  showcase the gifts, abilities, talents that they possess (for example;  they can roleplay, dramatize a play or Bible story, draw, sing, paint, compose and recite poems)
